About the Hiring Team
Game Research Center(GRC) is a department focusing on game industry study, game analysis, game design research, data analysis and game development supporting. We’re one of the world’s leading research facility in game industry, building a global knowledge tank to help our teams make better decisions. We’re looking for innovative and passionate team members who love all kinds of games and have insight about the challenging global market.

What the Role Entails
Perform interpretation and translation tasks between Korean and Chinese
Conduct for daily market data analysis of game products 
Provide insights on gaming and online culture-related issues 
Support industry trend research and report writing 
Carry out daily research and analysis on the gaming industry, with a focus on the Korean market (experience with the Japanese market is a plus) 
Research on game-related IT/Content industries (entertainment/films/drama/comics, etc.)

Who We Look For
Undergraduate student or above; previous internship or experience in related industries is preferred: Game, Entertainment, Research, etc.
Native-level Korean proficiency with excellent Mandarin Chinese speaking ability required; English/Japanese proficiency preferred 
Strong logical thinking, analytical ability, and communication skills 
Ability to flexibly adapt to various work environments and collaborative situations Ability to prioritize, meet strict deadlines, and maintain high attention to detail Ability to work autonomously, show initiative, and be self-motivated 
Strong interpersonal and communication skills in person and in writing 
Proficiency in MS Office (especially PowerPoint and Excel) 
Enthusiasm for IT/Game/Entertainment industry

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
